poll.notes: Recall weighting left UNVERIFIED: the primary (headline) weight's calibration list has no presidential-vote margin, recalled 2024 vote appears only in a SECOND weight, and the methodology summary (p.1) separately says the sample is weighted to the '2020 presidential election result and partisanship'. pollster.weighting_quote: Calibration: "The sample was calibrated to registered voter benchmarks by age ...; education ...; sex ... by marital status ...; leaned self-reported Party ID ...; WI region ... by L2-modeled Party ID ...; and 2024 vote mode (did not vote, voted early, voter on Election Day) by L2-modeled Party ID." Then: "A second weight was computed by following all previous steps, plus an additional calibration margin for recalled 2024 presidential vote."
pollster.method_locator: MLSP91Methodology.pdf, 'WEIGHTING' section, 'Calibration' subsection; summary paragraph on p.1 ('The sample is weighted to reflect demographic benchmarks of Wisconsin registered voters, the 2020 presidential election result and partisanship.')
